subject: general
question: The Howrah bridge was officially opened in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1943**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Howrah Bridge is situated on the Hooghly River, Kolkata, West Bengal. It was built in the year 1943.
 
• It is a balanced cantilever bridge.
 
• The Howrah Bridge is currently ranked the sixth-longest bridge of balanced cantilever bridge type in the world. When commissioned in 1943, it was the 3rd-longest cantilever bridge in the world.
 
• At the time it was built the name given to it was the New Howrah Bridge. It was renamed Rabindra Setu on 14 June 1965 after the great Bengali poet Rabindranath Tagore. But it is still popularly known by the name Howrah Bridge.
 
• It is linking the two cities Howrah and Kolkata (Calcutta). 
 
• Rabindranath Tagore was the first Indian and Asian to get a Nobel prize. He got a Nobel prize for Gitanjali in 1913 in the category of literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are 4 bridges on the Hooghly River. The other three are:

 
• Vidyasagar Setu (popularly called the Second Hooghly Bridge)
 
• The Vivekananda Setu
 
• The newly built Nivedita Setu.
